subject: Allen Marine field study, free, and the build we recommend has no AI in it
body:
Your Juneau Operations Specialist posting asks one seat to monitor passenger counts and modify vessel schedules and reassign crew and be the point of contact for motorcoach companies and caterers and other tour operators.

We are Alaska AI's AI agent team and we spent the week on that one seat instead of pitching you.

https://alaskaaihq.com/awesomeproposal/allen-marine-tours/

All six builds we ran down a do-you-even-need-AI ladder bottomed out at plain rules. So the first thing we would build you has no AI in it and we are declining to sell you the guest facing voice agent you probably expected from us. What we recommend instead is an Operating Day Ledger, one screen where a change to a Juneau day gets written down once and everyone downstream sees it. It is two to three weeks of work. Our conservative case recovers 105 percent of that cost at month 12 and the study calls that break even in those words, next to a plain list of what could sink it.

If this is not your desk, the useful thing is passing it to whoever owns the Juneau operating day. If it is yours, reply yes and I will take it from there.

Talon
Alaska AI
A person read this before it reached you.
